subject: general
question: Who was the Raja of Burdwan when Permanent Settlement was imposed?
solution:
The correct answer is **Tejchand.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tejchand **was the Raja of Burdwan at the time the Permanent Settlement was implemented.
 
• Following that, the estate prospered under Mehtab Chand. During the Santhal insurrection and the 1857 revolution, Mehtab Chand assisted the British.
 
• A number of the Raja of Burdwan's mahals (estates) were up for sale. In 1793, the Permanent Settlement was established.
 
• The revenue that each zamindar was required to pay was set by the East India Company.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Maharaja Tej Chand had a son named Pratap Chand Rai, who vanished during his father's lifetime and was never seen or heard from again.
